capabilities: handwrite, highlight and erase on Markdown notes with a stylus or mouse
annotate PDFs and flatten or export the ink
lasso, move, resize, rotate and copy-paste ink selections
attach ink to text so it follows edits across devices
extras: Free with an optional donation link. Includes an opt-in bug report recorder that sends stroke data (never note text) to the developer, with offline copy/save alternatives. Warns that hidden .handwriting/ folders are skipped by Obsidian Sync, iCloud and Dropbox unless a compatibility setting is enabled. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Planned features include handwriting-to-text OCR, search, and OneNote import.
motivation: The author missed the OneNote-style experience of drawing and typing on the same page from university and wanted to recreate it in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to handwrite with a pen or annotate PDFs on top of notes.

relations.evidence: drawing structures and typing labels on the same OneNote page felt like literal magic

summary: Stylus ink overlay for Markdown notes and PDFs that stores handwriting in sidecar files while notes stay plain .md files.
